content: claude -p headless: --output-format text|json|stream-json; stream-json needs --verbose. session_id comes from .session_id in json output and from the system/init event in stream-json; --resume <id> now finds a session by id in ANY project dir (v2.1.223+). Exit 0 on success, non-zero on failure, 143 on SIGTERM. SIGTERM leaves the in-flight turn unfinished, kills the process tree of running Bash commands, runs SessionEnd hooks; SIGINT ends the turn cleanly instead. Slow stream consumers: Claude Code waits for queued output to drain before exiting, capped at 30s. Piped stdin capped at 10MB. --bare skips ~/.claude skills/hooks/plugins/MCP/CLAUDE.md AND never reads OAuth creds (requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) - fatal if you depend on globally-installed skills. Without --bare, a -p session runs the target repo's .claude/settings.json hooks and .mcp.json servers with NO trust dialog and NO per-server approval. -p starts in Manual permission mode on every plan, so you must pass --permission-mode (auto/acceptEdits/dontAsk) or nothing gets approved. --permission-prompts none (v2.1.259+) makes unattended runs deny instead of waiting, and removes AskUserQuestion. Background subagents/workflows hold the process open up to 10 min idle (CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS).
